source.author: stat
source.text: arma premunt, nec vis conatibus ulla, sed ipsae in socios errare manus et corpora turba involvi prolapsa sua; manet ille ruentes angustus telis et inexpugnabilis obstat, non aliter Getieae si fas est credere Phlegrae armatum immensus Briarcus stetit aethera contra, hinc Phoebi pharetras, hinc torvae Pallados anguis, inde Pelethroniam praefixa cuspide pinum Martis, at hinc lasso mutata Pyracmone temnens fulmina, cum toto nequiquam obsessus Olympo tot queritur cessare manus: non segnior ardet huc illuc clipeum obiectam, seque ipse recedens circuit, interdum trepidis occurrit et instat spicula devellens, clipeo quae plurima toto fixa tremunt armantque virum saepe aspera passum volnera, sed nullum vitae in secreta receptum nee mortem sperare valet.
source.text_original: arma premunt, nec vis conatibus ulla, sed ipsae / in socios errare manus et corpora turba / involvi prolapsa sua; manet ille ruentes / angustus telis et inexpugnabilis obstat, / non aliter — Getieae si fas est credere Phlegrae — / armatum immensus Briarcus stetit aethera contra, / hinc Phoebi pharetras, hinc torvae Pallados anguis, / inde Pelethroniam praefixa cuspide pinum / Martis, at hinc lasso mutata Pyracmone temnens / fulmina, cum toto nequiquam obsessus Olympo / tot queritur cessare manus: non segnior ardet / huc illuc clipeum obiectam, seque ipse recedens / circuit, interdum trepidis occurrit et instat / spicula devellens, clipeo quae plurima toto / fixa tremunt armantque virum saepe aspera passum / volnera, sed nullum vitae in secreta receptum / nee mortem sperare valet.
source.text_english: Weapons press on them, yet there is no force in their efforts; instead, their own hands stray against their allies, and their bodies, having fallen, are entangled in the crowd. That one remains, blocking the assault with his weapons, narrow and impregnable. Not otherwise, if it is permitted to trust the story of Getic Phlegra, did the immense Briarcus stand armed against the sky, with Phoebus’ quivers on this side, on that the serpent of fierce Pallas, and elsewhere the Pelethronian pine with Mars’ spear-point fixed in it, and on this side, with his thunderbolts changed by weary Pyracmon, scorning them, while besieged in vain by the whole of Olympus, he complains that so many hands are at a loss: no less fiercely does he burn, moving his shield here and there, and as he withdraws he circles himself, at times he meets the trembling and presses hard, tearing out the spears, which, fixed fast in his entire shield, tremble in great number and arm the man, though he has often endured savage wounds; but he can find no secluded refuge for life, nor can he hope for death.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: illam Acamans habitat nudusque Pyragmon, has nimbi ventique domos et naufraga servat tempestas.
reuse.text_original: illam Acamans habitat nudusque Pyragmon, / has nimbi ventique domos et naufraga servat / tempestas.
reuse.text_english: Acamans dwells in that place, and naked Pyragmon too; these homes are preserved by storms and winds and by shipwrecking tempest.
